summary.one_liner: A curated "awesome" list of links for learning and practicing algorithms, covering courses, books, practice sites, visualizers, and cheat sheets.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style list of links, not software. It is organized by audience and purpose: Beginner-Friendly (YouTube courses, books, and interactive visualizers), Programming Contest (competitive programming sites, books, and blogs), Theory & Fundamentals (classic textbooks and MIT OpenCourseWare courses), Production System (performance engineering and cloud/distributed computing resources), Database (PostgreSQL query optimization), Special Topic (immutable data structures), Cheat Sheet, and Related Awesome Lists. Entries are one-line descriptions with links to external resources. The README does not describe any code or runnable project in this repository.
use_cases: finding free algorithm courses and lectures
visualizing data structures and algorithms step by step
locating algorithm cheat sheets for interview prep
exploring resources on query optimization and distributed systems
notable: Covers beginner, contest, theory, and production-level resources in one list
Includes interactive visualizers such as VisuAlgo and See Algorithms
Links to MIT OpenCourseWare algorithm courses and classic textbooks
Lists competitive programming judges such as Codeforces, UVA, and ProjectEuler
caveats: Contains only links and short descriptions; no code or software to install
Some linked resources may go out of date, as the README gives no maintenance information
